evals.prompt: set up a backup policy for our orders database
evals.expected_output: Starts from a written RPO for the dataset agreed with the business owner, derives backup frequency and continuous/incremental methods from that RPO, sets retention per tier with an explicit reason, ensures at least one offsite immutable copy, and requires encryption at rest with separately-managed keys.

evals.prompt: we've never actually tried restoring from our backups
evals.expected_output: Flags this as effectively having no backup, and schedules a full restore into an isolated environment on a fixed cadence (e.g. monthly), run by someone other than whoever built the backup job, measuring actual restore time against the stated RTO.

evals.prompt: we keep backups in the same aws account as prod, that's fine right?
evals.expected_output: Pushes back, explaining that same-account backups share the same compromise/deletion blast radius as production, and requires replicating to a separate account or region with object-lock/write-once storage and restricted retention-modification permissions.
